summary: Lixiang Education Holding filed a Form 6-K with notice of its annual general meeting and proxy materials. The company proposes to issue 20 billion Class A shares to investors and 5 billion Class B shares to CEO Biao Wei for total consideration of $12.5 million, with ADSs deposited at Citibank and a follow-on Form F-1 for resale. This is a capital raise contingent on shareholder approval, not a classic special situation. The filing is routine in nature despite the large issuance, which appears dilutive. Watch for shareholder approval and CSRC filing; no premium or tender terms stated.
